title: Name a calculation
summary: Haskell: Name a calculation. Call twice 7.
introduction: Functions take inputs written after their name. This function doubles a number.

blocks.text: Install GHC. Save one example as lesson.hs and run runghc lesson.hs. Keep any definitions above main in the same file.
The function input becomes 4. Multiplication returns 8.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Function calls use spaces, not a required pair of call parentheses.
